meta.homeTitle: iTester: eye drop reminders that never let you miss a dose
meta.homeDescription: A simple app that reminds you when to take each eye drop, with the right wait between drops, and keeps a caregiver in sync.
meta.aboutTitle: About Ahaan: why this app exists
meta.aboutDescription: The story behind iTester, the eye medication reminder app built by Ahaan.

hero.title: Never miss an eye drop again
hero.subtitle: When you use several eye drops, it is hard to remember each dose and the wait between them. This app does it for you.
hero.mockAlt: The app home screen showing today's eye drops and the next reminder.

problem.title: Eye drops are harder than they look
problem.text: Many eye conditions need two, three or more different drops every day. Each one has its own time, and some must wait several minutes after the one before. It is easy to lose track.

cards.title: Forgetting a dose
cards.text: A busy day or a new routine, and a dose slips by without anyone noticing.

cards.title: Getting the wait wrong
cards.text: Drops put in too close together wash each other out, so neither works as well.

cards.title: Mixing up bottles
cards.text: Small bottles with similar caps and labels look almost the same.

solution.title: One app, one clear plan
solution.text: Add your drops once. The app works out the schedule, the right gap between drops, and tells you and your caregiver what to do next.

steps.title: Add your drops
steps.text: Enter each medicine and take a photo of the bottle.
steps.alt: Screen for adding an eye drop with a photo of its bottle.

steps.title: Get reminded at the right time
steps.text: A loud, full-screen alarm for each drop, spaced correctly.
steps.alt: Full-screen reminder with large Taken and Snooze buttons.

steps.title: Caregiver stays in sync
steps.text: A family member can see what was taken and what was missed.
steps.alt: Caregiver view listing today's doses as taken or missed.

items.title: Dose tracking
items.text: Mark each dose as taken and see your history at a glance.

items.title: Smart reminders
items.text: Reminders keep the correct gap between one drop and the next.

items.title: Caregiver and patient sync
items.text: A caregiver can manage and check on a loved one's doses.

items.title: Large, high-contrast buttons
items.text: Easy to see and tap, even with low vision or shaky hands.

items.title: Photos of your bottles
items.text: See a picture of the exact bottle so you pick up the right one.

items.title: Multiple languages
items.text: Use the app in English, Hindi or Tamil.

about.builtText: iTester is a mobile app with loud reminders, correct spacing between drops, photos of each bottle, and a caregiver view. It works in English, Hindi and Tamil.
